#!/usr/bin/env python3
import ctypes
import time
from ctypes import CDLL, c_void_p, c_double, c_uint32, c_int

# Load Core Graphics framework
cg = CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreGraphics.framework/Versions/A/CoreGraphics')

# Define CGPoint structure
class CGPoint(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('x', c_double), ('y', c_double)]

# Function declarations
CGEventCreateMouseEvent = cg.CGEventCreateMouseEvent
CGEventCreateMouseEvent.argtypes = [c_void_p, c_uint32, CGPoint, c_uint32]
CGEventCreateMouseEvent.restype = c_void_p

CGEventPost = cg.CGEventPost
CGEventPost.argtypes = [c_uint32, c_void_p]
CGEventPost.restype = None

CFRelease = cg.CFRelease
CFRelease.argtypes = [c_void_p]
CFRelease.restype = None

# Event types
kCGEventLeftMouseDown = 2
kCGEventLeftMouseUp = 3
kCGEventHIDEventTap = 0

def send_click(x, y):
    """Send a mouse click (touch) at the specified coordinates"""
    point = CGPoint(x, y)
    
    # Send mouse down
    event_down = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseDown, point, 0)
    CGEventPost(kCGEventHIDEventTap, event_down)
    CFRelease(event_down)
    
    time.sleep(0.1)
    
    # Send mouse up
    event_up = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseUp, point, 0)
    CGEventPost(kCGEventHIDEventTap, event_up)
    CFRelease(event_up)
    
    time.sleep(0.2)

# Click on the Team Standup room
# Looking at the screenshot, it appears to be at approximately (240, 980)
print("Clicking on Team Standup room...")
send_click(240, 980)
print("Click sent!")
EOF

kCGEventLeftMouseDown = 2
kCGEventLeftMouseUp = 3
kCGEventHIDEventTap = 0

    event_up = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseUp, point, 0)
